name: Treshala's Pendant
summary: Treshala's Pendant is an intimate heirloom of bonding belonging to Treshala Fallowbrook, a night elf dwelling in Darnassus. Carried into southern Kalimdor by her husband, Heralath, it was ripped away by the quilboar in Razorfen Kraul as he lay dying.

sections.title: Token of Devotion
sections.body: The pendant serves as a symbol of deep marital devotion between Treshala and Heralath Fallowbrook. Before embarking on perilous journeys away from Teldrassil, Heralath carried the bonding necklace close as a reminder of his home and his beloved.

sections.title: Lost in the Briars
sections.body: When Heralath ventured into the thorny depths of Razorfen Kraul, the savage quilboar fell upon his party. Stripped from him in his final agonizing moments, the pendant was looted by one of the tusked defenders. As his life ebbed away, Heralath's dying wish was for an adventurer to wrest the keepsake from his killers and carry both the trinket and the tragic news of his fate home to Darnassus.

faq.answer: It is a personal bonding pendant belonging to Treshala Fallowbrook, carried by her husband Heralath as a keepsake of their union before he met his end in Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: How did the pendant end up in Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: Heralath Fallowbrook carried it during an expedition into Razorfen Kraul. When quilboar ambushed and mortally wounded him, one of the beasts looted the necklace from his body.

faq.q: Who asks for the pendant to be recovered?
faq.answer: Heralath Fallowbrook himself begs passing adventurers to find the stolen pendant as he lies dying within Razorfen Kraul, pleading that it be returned to his wife in Darnassus alongside news of his death.

faq.q: Who receives the pendant once it is recovered?
aliases: where do i take the pendant
faq.answer: The pendant is delivered to Heralath's grieving widow, Treshala Fallowbrook, who resides in the night elf capital of Darnassus atop Teldrassil.

angles.text: Recovering the pendant honors the tragic final moments of a fellow kaldorei who perished far from the safety of Teldrassil's boughs.
Carrying this token back to Darnassus brings somber closure to an Alliance widow mourning a fallen explorer.
